THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-0r.anc: You have climbed far, little spark. Show me what you carried up my Spire.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KLEE.0-1r.cha: I saved this one for the top! You might wanna cover your ears!
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-0r.a: The curtain falls at last, Regina of All Waters. Was it a performance, or was it real?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-FURINA.0-1r.c: Both. It was always both. Now - the people rejoice, and their Regina takes her bow.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-0r.a: Priestess. You could have stayed on your island. Why climb so far from the people who need you?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-KOKOMI.0-1r.c: Because I couldn't be sure this place would never reach them. I'd rather find out myself than wait at home.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-0r.an: Grand Master. Five years on the road, and still you climb. What did you expect to find at the top?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-VARKA.0-1r.ch: A good fight, then the road home. Mondstadt has waited long enough.
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-YAE.0-0r.anci: Guuji. You climbed my Spire as if you were reading it. How does it end?
THE_ARCHITECT.talk.KLEEMOD-YAE.0-1r.char: With a twist, naturally. Do keep up. I would hate to edit you out.
